title: Possible Kafka SASL PLAIN password in source
description: A committed Kafka SASL PLAIN password was found in a configuration or source file. Anyone with repository access can use it to reach the service it names until it is rotated. Shape-only: the match does not prove the value is live.
remediation: Rotate the credential in the provider console, check its access logs, and load the replacement from a secret manager at run time.
limitation: Shape-only: matches the documented syntax of this configuration form. It cannot prove the value is a live credential.

tests.line: # audit: jaas = "PlainLoginModule required username="svc" password="AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA"" present
